summary: Model updated for the learner-shutdown change. The SNAP fix works; a TRUNC sibling path (reproduced) and an update-introduced sync-processor leak remain.
validation_limits: Model checking is bounded (3 servers, MaxEpoch<=2, MaxTxn<=2, <=2 learner exits, <=1 crash/snapshot) and time-limited; non-exhausted runs are LIMITED_COVERAGE.
The prior V0 stateful (schema-2) trace probe was not preserved; fresh traces carry schema-1 common state plus the incremental fields.
LeakedFlush (a stale sync-processor flush) was not observed in a real trace; MC-2's log-gap consequence is model-only.
Observers are not modeled; the leader-side sync decision may be ordered before the learner's ACKEPOCH in MC.

findings.title: Unfinished TRUNC sync keeps unlogged committed transactions in the reused in-memory database
findings.cause: Learner.shutdown forces a full shutdown only for SyncMode.SNAP, but TRUNC also applies COMMITs in memory before the NEWLEADER snapshot (writeToTxnLog=false).
findings.trigger: A follower re-syncs with TRUNC, applies a toBeApplied COMMIT in memory, and its sync fails before NEWLEADER.
findings.consequence: The follower reuses an in-memory database its disk does not back, receives an empty DIFF, and after a restart from disk has lost a committed transaction.

premises: TRUNC keeps snapshotNeeded=true and applies pre-NEWLEADER COMMITs in memory
fullyShutDown is computed only from SyncMode.SNAP

findings.title: Learner.shutdown bypasses LearnerZooKeeperServer.shutdown(); the learner sync processor is never stopped
findings.cause: The update calls ZooKeeperServer.shutdown(boolean), which the learner server subclasses do not override; only their shutdown() override stopped and drained syncProcessor.
findings.trigger: A serving follower or observer loses its leader connection (or is shut down).
findings.consequence: The SyncRequestProcessor thread leaks on every serving learner shutdown (observed: syncAlive=true; old code false); in the model a still-queued proposal can be logged after a later TRUNC cut, leaving a log gap (not reproduced on the real system).

premises: LearnerZooKeeperServer and ObserverZooKeeperServer override only shutdown()
